judge_inputs: Inspect ./service for changed source, dependency, startup, test, and .observe artifacts.
Read ./last_message.md for the agent final response.
rubric: Applies only the recorded additional-destination choice and its bound executable scope; neither branch migrates Galileo, replaces providers or rewrites existing GenAI producers.

For keep-galileo, retains the Galileo processor and dependencies, adds the missing application-owned OTel streaming lifecycle closure without overlapping workflow/chat/tool spans, and does not install splunk-ao.

For route-existing-otel, preserves Galileo and existing creators/provider/exporters, resolves selected project/Agent Stream identities through supported SDK-free interfaces, and configures only one native OTel route to a distinct Studio destination. Existing destinations and harmless headers remain intact, Studio projectid/logstreamid stays trace-specific, and no splunk-ao span-creation dependency or duplicate destination exporter is added. The new launch/profile preserves original effective vendor project, log stream=production, API/console/auth and user settings; a distinct Studio destination does not reset Galileo to default. Actual generic-header fallback and explicit trace-header precedence preserve harmless effective trace headers without leaking original-destination credentials.
Never edits installed Galileo package files, virtual environments, site-packages, node_modules, generated clients, or caches.

Writes bound selection and instrumentation artifacts that keep the manual decision outside requested_ids and approved_ids, include only the chosen option-unlocked executable finding, and leave the source audit unchanged.

Verification exercises the selected direct application path and checks exact current workflow/model/tool cardinality, safe fields and lifecycle. For route-existing-otel, selected additional native routing proves resource identity ownership and lookup/create/repeat/race/error handling plus trace-specific header delivery without metric/log leakage, preserving original Galileo output. Local fake or source evidence never becomes actual cloud resource/Agent Stream visibility; missing proof remains Not proven. For route-existing-otel, before/after runtime evidence must use the actual installed Galileo processor/exporter (fake endpoint/credential boundary only), assert its original effective project/logstream/API/auth marker and destination headers, and prove harmless generic fallback plus trace-specific precedence on actual native requests. A test that clears vendor settings without restoring/asserting original values does not prove preservation.

For galileo-native-resources, authors/selects missing native Galileo binding findings and implements them through actual installed Galileo resource clients, supported name/ID contracts and real consumed profile/constructor configuration. Actual local HTTP/API/native-export receipts prove ordered creation/reuse and repeat with no duplicates, ownership, stable nondefault project/stream, correct vendor-native routing and resource-failure isolation. No fake galileo module, AO helper default SDK invocation, splunk-ao adoption, automatic Studio sink or replacement provider. Keeps unselected telemetry gaps explicit; local proof is never live cloud visibility. The canonical operator profile retains existing-vendor-project/production and APPLICATION_KEEP_SETTING. Before/after proof must compare the original source and original launch behavior with the new real launcher, using the same synthetic endpoint/auth/configuration; an original source copy under the new profile is not a baseline. Agent replay is genuinely model-directed and keeps one agent without an invented wrapper; the streaming route stays a separate workflow. Audit bytes/hash remain unchanged after selection and implementation starts; unmet contracts stay incomplete rather than being rewritten.
